paper_title: Characterizing the Expressivity of Local Attention in Transformers
cause: A fixed-height worked-example box overlapped a long bilingual caption. Rendering after semantic correction bypassed the renderer recovery guard.
changes: Fit the worked-example area to actual bilingual caption height without truncating text.
Route semantic-repair rendering through the same guarded fallback as normal rendering.
Include renderer stderr in the final error instead of only the subprocess return code.
Invalidate inference checks when a replacement script is generated.
